An EXTRA key can never be a divergence — §2 forward compatibility permits extension fields explicitly. THE SEMANTICS STILL COME FIRST, and they are now MEASURED rather than asserted. One function with an Fs effect and NO declaration anywhere: java emits `undeclared:["Fs"]` (reading absence-of-declaration as declared-empty, so every effect is a violation); ts and swift emit `undeclared:[]` (reading it as not participating); rust omits the field. So java is the OUTLIER 3-to-1 with rust abstaining, and §2's own gloss — 'inferred − declared (violations); empty in audit' — carries both readings at once. Adding the four keys to rust before settling that sentence would buy agreement on SHAPE over a live disagreement on MEANING.
